We’re hiring: Vice President - Restoration & Wildlife | Nagpur, Maharashtra At Farmers for Forests, restoration goes beyond planting trees. It means protecting forest landscapes, working alongside communities and finding practical ways for people and wildlife to coexist. We’re looking for a Vice President - Restoration & Wildlife to lead this work across the Tadoba and Gadchiroli landscapes. The role will involve leading rewilding and habitat restoration around Tadoba, strengthening forest protection and fire prevention in Gadchiroli, and developing community-led approaches to human-elephant coexistence. Working closely with our Executive Director, the person will shape programme strategy, lead field teams, manage budgets and build strong partnerships with forest officials, local communities and other stakeholders. Who should apply? We’re looking for someone with 8-12 years of relevant experience, including 4-5 years leading large-scale field programmes, and hands-on experience in forest restoration, forestry, wildlife conservation or community-based natural resource management. The position is based in Nagpur and involves extensive travel to field locations across Chandrapur and Gadchiroli. If you have the experience to lead complex field programmes and are committed to working closely with communities and conservation partners, we’d like to hear from you. Interested? Scan the QR code on the post to read the full job description and apply.
